esqlQuery.esql: FROM metrics-azure_openai.metrics-* | WHERE azure.open_ai.provisioned_managed_utilization_v2.avg IS NOT NULL | STATS avg_util = AVG(azure.open_ai.provisioned_managed_utilization_v2.avg), max_util = MAX(azure.open_ai.provisioned_managed_utilization_v2.avg) BY azure.resource.name | WHERE avg_util > 90 | SORT avg_util DESC
